entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact transparent full-body portrait. Keep this SAME elderly man, precise face, expression, outfit, hands, pose, red six-string electric guitar, strap and the instrument plug already correctly inserted into the guitar's oval chrome output-jack plate. Correct the incomplete setup: add ONE compact realistic black BATTERY-POWERED guitar practice amplifier beside his feet on the VIEWER LEFT, at the same ground-contact height as his shoes. It is an unbranded small rectangular cabinet with dark woven speaker grille, top/front control panel, simple knobs, a tiny lit power indicator, and a clearly visible FRONT INPUT JACK. The very same SINGLE black instrument cable from the guitar must visibly run down naturally in a gentle loose curve and END IN A PLUG FULLY SEATED INTO THAT AMPLIFIER'S FRONT INPUT JACK. Show both connected ends clearly: guitar jack -> one continuous black rubber lead -> amplifier INPUT jack. REMOVE the disconnected plug currently lying loose beside the floor loop. There must be NO loose unplugged cable end anywhere, no extra signal cables. The guitar cable must not connect to a speaker cone, knob, strap button or hidden back panel. Cable may loop a little at foot level, but both ends visibly connect to equipment. A small front label may read exactly INPUT, no brand logos or other words. Amp must be physically supported with its base at the shoe contact line, not floating. Leave generous fully transparent margins around man, amplifier and cord. If more space is needed, slightly zoom out the entire composition and shift man a little to the right to fit the small amplifier at picture left; do not crop or change his pose, face or clothing. Preserve genuinely transparent alpha background, no actual floor plane, scenery, wall, shadows or glow. Same portrait 1024x1536 canvas. This should look like a complete playable guitar-and-amp setup, one man, one guitar, one battery-powered amplifier, one cable joining them.
